What the record says

  • The Giants' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is underdog of 7 or more (since 2002): 44-33-1 against the spread, a 57.1% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is road favorite (all time): 58-62-2, 48.3%.
  • On totals since 2002, the over hits most often when the closing number is 42 to 44.5 (63-56-2, 52.9% over) and least often at 45 to 47.5 (37-56-2, 39.8%).
  • All time they have covered 49.0% at home and 51.9% on the road, a 2.9 point edge on the road.
